Floodcast est un podcast de culture géné: Floodcast is a general-knowledge comedy podcast that tackles all kinds of topics with lightness and intelligence. It moves between pop culture, odd facts and social debates in a free format that owns its rambling structure.
Le duo humoristique Florent Dorin et Adr: The comedy duo Florent Dorin and Adrien Ménielle, recorded in a cellar on a shoestring with a real love of podcasting. Sincere, kind, generational humour — neither TV nor stand-up, a bit rough around the edges and proud of it. Proof that with basic means and passion you can get close to a million subscribers and fill the Salle Pleyel three times. Our verdict: ended after 250 episodes and 10 seasons, the archive remains a feel-good treasure. Start with the episodes featuring Pierre Niney or Pio Marmaï — guaranteed laughter.
